message: In the under-deck vertical Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) retrofit (C1), the crowd-walking vertical acceleration at about 1.9 Hertz (Hz) has needed proof of comfortable level, Structural Dynamics Lead and Vibration Control Specialist. To check it I used standards comparison reusing the resonant response calculation (E1) and the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6) with the detuned damping estimate (E8). I found about 0.20 metres per second squared controlled versus 1.75 metres per second squared baseline below 0.50 metres per second squared limit, according to Human Induced Vibrations of Steel Structures (HIVOSS), 2008. I propose holding Comfort Class 1 (CL1) meaning maximum comfort as build target. My position: not ready because joint proposal and girder fatigue review are pending. In the concealed under-deck support frame (C2), the installation sequence and inspection access has risk of long deck closure, Retrofit Integration Architect and Manager. To check it I used build review reusing the concealed mounting cross-section (E7) with clearance from the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6). I found fit below soffit with 30 millimetre clearance for under 12 millimetre stroke allowing night works from below with lockable hatches and shim re-tuning, according to French Assessment Service for Roads and Motorways (Setra), 2006. I propose bolted cross-frames installed from below with corrosion protection and re-tuning procedure. My position: not ready because blocking process check from Manager needs closure.
